scope: Вымышленные данные; создание схемы исключительно в базе SQLite в памяти
setup: CREATE TABLE orders (order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, amount_rub INTEGER); INSERT INTO orders VALUES (1,10,'paid',1000),(2,10,'paid',2000),(3,20,'cancelled',500),(4,30,'paid',NULL); CREATE TABLE lines (line_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER NOT NULL, sku TEXT NOT NULL); INSERT INTO lines VALUES (1,1,'A'),(2,1,'B'),(3,2,'C'),(4,4,'D');

queries.sql: SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE status='paid' ORDER BY order_id
SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE status='paid' AND amount_rub IS NULL ORDER BY order_id
SELECT customer_id,COUNT(*),SUM(amount_rub) FROM orders WHERE status='paid' GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY customer_id
SELECT customer_id,COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status='paid' GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*)>=2 ORDER BY customer_id
SELECT SUM(o.amount_rub) FROM orders AS o JOIN lines AS l ON o.order_id=l.order_id WHERE o.status='paid'
SELECT SUM(amount_rub) FROM orders WHERE status='paid'
SELECT SUM(amount_rub) FROM orders WHERE order_id<0
